ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) distribution with localized high-intensity (white) regions. Visual estimation of high-to-low intensity pixel ratio is approximately 1:8 across visible surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous white blob located at the distal tip of the left lobe. Scattered lower-density white mottling concentrated on the mid-left lobe. Discrete vertical high-contrast white streak located on the medial section of the right lobe trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression, estimated at approximately 135 degrees relative to the lobe intersection points.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrated profile along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of variations is most pronounced on the inner medial regions of both lobes, transitioning to smoother segments near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong upward sweep with convex curvature near the notch transitioning into a dorsal concavity towards the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense white pixel cluster at the left distal tip. Sparse, roughly circular white pixel clusters (approx. 4-8 pixel diameter) scattered across the mid-section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical high-contrast linear disruption (rake mark) visible on the right fluke lobe, roughly equidistant between the notch and the right tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring or callosity covering the outer margin of the left fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity white pixel masking along the ventral-water interface due to spray and turbulence, obscuring the leading edge boundary.
